contract.title: TWIN-50 测试夹具去旁路净化、全栈921600垂直端到端PTY预检与真机HIL终验
contract.accepted_scope: Software, static opcode alignment (check_opcode_alignment.py), and 921600 PTY virtual-MCU hardware-mode full-stack vertical-slice integration verification of debug_reconciliation_probe.py after completely removing twin46_mc_bridge.c normalize_ap_temp_wire_frame and ctypes notify bypasses, driving 100% via ui-gateway HTTP control APIs across the 5 business categories (temperature, motion/homing/stop, 5x5 bed-leveling grid, filament/slot, job/G-code), unit-specific offline sentinel (2147483646 mdeg / 32767 ddC) and strict HTTP 503 lock checks, live negative fault injection and live recovery loop against the running ui-gateway, and deploy_twin.sh lifecycle. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU SWD/USB/UART HIL are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 消费TWIN-47 MC控制命令闭环与真机交叉编译固件
消费TWIN-48 TH级联控制闭环与真机交叉编译固件
消费TWIN-49 AP去Mock全链路控制与deploy_twin.sh脚本
